messages:
raj_support: P1 escalation — Alder Health onboarding blocked at activation, reported via onboarding ticket #7892. Customer in trial, renewal touchpoint in ~45 days. Can CS pick up comms + priority handling? :rotating_light:

emma_cs: Thanks Raj. Quick summary of failure state and exact error? Need provisioning state (workspace, keys) to include in comms.

raj_support: Provisioning fails on KMS bind step. Seen in 3 repeated attempts. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-7892

raj_support: ```
ERROR: provisioning failed for org_id=ald-238
  File "/srv/provision/main.py", line 214, in bind_kms
KeyError: 'kms_key'
```

raj_support: We retried same inputs, no quota errors. No tenant record created in DB.

marta_se: @raj_support thanks — looks like the service account never received the KMS IAM role in their cloud project. We can do a manual bind if Alder approves. Workaround option: create a temporary key and skip the customer bind to finish activation, then rotate to customer's key post-activation.

emma_cs: Good. I'll draft comms. Need to (1) notify Alder Health with ETA and workaround options, (2) offer an activation window / walkthrough, (3) surface renewal risk to the AM.

kevin_pm: Heads up — renewal touchpoint scheduled ~45d out, ACV is moderate. If activation delayed >7 days, flag for renewal enablement. Approve offering up to 25% trial credit if activation takes >72h.

emma_cs: Draft comms (please review):
"Hi Ana (@ana_ald) — quick update: we hit an issue during provisioning that prevented binding your KMS key. We can (A) perform a short manual IAM step with your consent to finish activation in ~2 hours, or (B) apply a temporary key so you can go live immediately and then we’ll rotate to your key. We recommend option B for immediate testing. We can also extend your trial by 48 hours / offer credit if you prefer. Reply with preferred option and a convenient window." :email:

Can team sign off on messaging and timeline?

marta_se: Messaging lgtm. For option A we need a 30-minute window and an IAM steps doc for the customer. For option B we'll need SRE sign-off to create and later rotate a temp key.

raj_support: I can run a manual bind in the #eng-oncall window; if that fails we escalate to SRE. For temp-key I need SRE approval for bypassing bind check.

deploy-bot: Deployment note — no infra changes to provisioning service in last 48h.

kevin_pm: Approve up to 25% trial credit for Cedar/this account if delay >72h. Emma, add this to the comms as an explicit offer.

emma_cs: Added. Owners assigned: Support (raj_support) — attempt manual bind + rerun provisioning; SE (marta_se) — prepare IAM instruction doc + temp-key checklist; CS (emma_cs) — send comms, offer credit, schedule call; PM (kevin_pm) — approve credit and contingency. Next step: Raj to attempt manual bind within next 2 hours and post status here. If unresolved, CS to send comms offering temp-key + credit.

raj_support: Starting manual bind attempt now. Will update in-thread. :wrench:

emma_cs: Standing by to send the email once you confirm. Will ping @ana_ald when ready.

raj_support: Update — manual bind failed, same KeyError. Escalating to SRE for an IAM role audit. @eng-sre please advise. :eyes:

sre_oncall: Acknowledged. Investigating IAM policies and service-account bindings. ETA ~45m.

emma_cs: Noted. I'll prepare the comms for option B including the credit offer so we can send immediately if SRE needs more time.

marta_se: IAM instruction draft and temp-key checklist incoming, will post within 30m.

emma_cs: Agreed owners and timeline. If SRE needs more time, CS will proactively offer a scheduled walkthrough and trial extension. Recording actions and will follow up in 1h. :spiral_calendar:

raj_support: SRE found the root cause — missing org tag on the service account caused the KMS bind to be skipped. SRE applying fix now and will re-run provisioning in ~15m.

emma_cs: Great, please confirm when provisioning completes. After success I'll send tailored comms and book a kickoff call.

raj_support: Provisioning succeeded. Org created and onboarding flow progressing. Marking this P1 resolved from support side. :tada:

emma_cs: Sending comms now with apology, summary of options considered, and the 48h trial-credit as promised. Copying AM and renewal owner. We'll close the loop in 24h to confirm product adoption and any further enablement needs.

kevin_pm: Thanks team. Please log root cause and run a short post-mortem for the provisioning path to avoid regressions around org-tag handling.

emma_cs: Will do. Closing thread after follow-up confirmation with Alder Health. :white_check_mark:
